cutscene.starmine.kerrigan.freed1: ...The voice in my head. It's gone.
cutscene.starmine.kerrigan.freed2: Amun held the Swarm through me. Not anymore — my brood and the leviathan are yours, Commander.
cutscene.starmine.kerrigan.freed3: My part of the key lies beside me. Take it. When you go for Amun, the Swarm goes with you.
cutscene.starmine.raynor.freed1: Damn... felt like somebody else was doin' the drivin'.
cutscene.starmine.raynor.freed2: Amun had his hooks in me and the whole fleet. Raiders — stand down. We're with the Commander now.
cutscene.starmine.raynor.freed3: Grab that piece of the key, friend. We've got a god to put down.
cutscene.starmine.artanis.freed1: En Taro Adun... the darkness has left my mind.
cutscene.starmine.artanis.freed2: Amun's whispers turned the Daelaam against you. Forgive us, Commander — the fleet answers to you now.
cutscene.starmine.artanis.freed3: Take the key that lies here. When it is whole, the Golden Armada will stand with you.
cutscene.starmine.abathur.freed1: Strange. Sequence... interrupted. Foreign strand in all essence. Amun's.
cutscene.starmine.abathur.freed2: Strand removed. Brood, lair, all pathways — yours now. Better use than his.
cutscene.starmine.abathur.freed3: Leviathan comes to the high sky now. Overlord will carry you. Climb. Find Kerrigan.
cutscene.starmine.swann.freed1: Ow... somebody hit the reset button on my head. Thanks, Commander.
cutscene.starmine.swann.freed2: Amun had the whole crew — me, the boys, the turrets, everything. The base is yours now, and so's every wrench in it.
cutscene.starmine.swann.freed3: The Hyperion's coming down from hiding. Hop in the medivac — she'll fly you right into Jimmy's hangar.
cutscene.starmine.karax.freed1: My thoughts... are my own again. Amun's whisper is silent.
cutscene.starmine.karax.freed2: The nexus, the warriors, the forges — I give them to you, Commander. We were his instruments too long.
cutscene.starmine.karax.freed3: The mothership answers again. My warp prism will carry you to her hangar; Artanis waits within.
cutscene.starmine.tosh.freed1: Huh. Amun's grip slips, mon. Didn't like it anyway.
cutscene.starmine.tosh.freed2: Spectres don't take orders from fallen gods. We'll see who hunts who now.
cutscene.starmine.tosh.freed3: My blades are yours, Commander. For a price, of course... later.
cutscene.starmine.zeratul.freed1: The shadow lifts... I see clearly once more.
cutscene.starmine.zeratul.freed2: Amun bound even me. You have my gratitude, and my blade.
cutscene.starmine.zeratul.freed3: The xel'naga's prophecy is not yet fulfilled. We will end this together.
cutscene.starmine.zagara.freed1: The voice... it is gone. Zagara thinks for herself again!
cutscene.starmine.zagara.freed2: You broke the dark one's hold. Zagara respects strength.
cutscene.starmine.zagara.freed3: The brood is yours to command. Point, and we devour.
cutscene.starmine.horner.freed1: All hands, the interference is gone — we're ours again!
cutscene.starmine.horner.freed2: That was not my finest hour, Commander. Thank you.
cutscene.starmine.horner.freed3: The fleet stands with you. Set a course for Amun.
cutscene.starmine.stukov.freed1: Ah... my head is clear. Clearer than it has been in years.
cutscene.starmine.stukov.freed2: Amun thought he could use what is left of me. He was wrong.
cutscene.starmine.stukov.freed3: My swarm and my ship are at your disposal, comrade.
cutscene.starmine.selendis.freed1: The Khala... I feel it again. Amun's voice is silenced.
cutscene.starmine.selendis.freed2: You have freed an executor of the Daelaam. I will not forget.
cutscene.starmine.selendis.freed3: My fleet will strike at Amun's heart beside yours.

cutscene.starmine.artifact.1: The key is whole. The way into the Void lies open — Amun waits beyond it.
cutscene.starmine.artifact.2: He made puppets of us all. Now he will learn what the Swarm does to those who would be its master.
cutscene.starmine.artifact.3: Every ship we've got — vikings, medivacs, the works. Load 'em up and send 'em through!
cutscene.starmine.artifact.4: Phoenixes, the void ray, the warp prism — into the light, my brothers.
cutscene.starmine.artifact.5: Commander, our people'll hold the first island past that portal. They'll be waitin' on your orders.
cutscene.starmine.artifact.6: Break his shards first. While they stand, Amun cannot fall.
cutscene.starmine.artifact.7: We return to our ships. Strike true, Commander. En Taro Tassadar.

book.starmine.guide.1:
StarMine
Field Guide

Three races of StarCraft II have come to this world: the Zerg, the Terrans and the Protoss.

This book tells how to live among them - and how to command them.

book.starmine.guide.3:
1. First steps

You start alone. The main bases of the three races lie about 480 blocks from where you first appeared. Wild units are foes to every player; units of your own fight for you.
book.starmine.guide.5:
2. Your base

A main building - hatchery, command center or nexus - placed from a spawn egg founds your base: 50 minerals and 4 workers. One base per dimension, shared by all three races.
book.starmine.guide.6: Survival way: a map with 8 armor shards of a race round it makes that race's supply platform. Fill it with ores, ingots, gems or vespene worth 500 minerals and right-click it with the command panel: a transport brings a worker.
book.starmine.guide.7:
3. Command view

Craft the command panel: a map, 4 repeaters and 4 comparators. Hold it and press B: a camera from above. WASD moves, the wheel lifts, Q and E turn. Left click selects, right click orders.
book.starmine.guide.8: Ctrl+digit makes a group, F2 selects the army. The command card uses SC2 hotkeys: M move, S stop, H hold, P patrol, A attack; workers build with B and V. The minimap marks every main base: Z, T, P and yours.
book.starmine.guide.9:
4. Resources

Minerals: workers mine ores and valuable blocks and carry them home. Blue mineral crystals hold 500 each, 5 a trip. A crystal can't be broken; your hand takes a shard.
book.starmine.guide.10: Vespene is a slow green liquid rising in veins from bedrock to a geyser. A gas building (extractor, refinery, assimilator) goes on an outlet. An open vent grows like a volcano until something covers it.
book.starmine.guide.11: Supply comes from overlords, supply depots and pylons. Prices, build times and supply follow StarCraft II. Research raises weapons and armor from 1 to 3; zerg grow a lair and a hive.
book.starmine.guide.12:
5. Taking control

In the command view select ONE of your fighters and press U: you become that unit - its body, health, shields, speed and weapons. Your inventory becomes its modules.
book.starmine.guide.13: Right-click the weapon module to fire where you aim; an ability module casts as the unit would. V leaves the unit. If it dies you are not hurt: you return to the command view.
book.starmine.guide.14:
6. Suits and modules

Units killed by you or your army drop armor shards of their race, sometimes an ability module. Shards make a race suit, crafted like vanilla armor.
book.starmine.guide.15:
Terran suit: as strong as diamond, hard to knock back.
Protoss suit: shields of 4 hearts that come back.
Zerg suit: regeneration, faster on creep.

Modules work only in the full suit of their race.
book.starmine.guide.16: A module has 24 uses. Recipe: 3 armor shards of its race, 2 mineral shards and a vespene bucket (the bucket comes back).
book.starmine.guide.17:
7. Zerg

The swarm grows from a hatchery: larvae become cocoons, cocoons become units. A drone turns INTO a building. Creep spreads round hatcheries and tumors; on it zerg run faster and heal.
book.starmine.guide.18: Zerglings, banelings, roaches, hydralisks, lurkers, mutalisks, infestors, ultralisks... Wild zerg hate every living thing, raid villages and dig tunnels. Glowing flesh and tumors keep monsters from spawning.
book.starmine.guide.19: Nydus corridors: a nydus network by a zerg base, a winding tunnel of liquid creep 64-112 blocks long, a nydus worm at the far end. Zerg rush through and guard the worm. Over the lair floats the leviathan.
book.starmine.guide.20:
8. Terrans

An SCV builds the command center, supply depots, barracks, factory and starport. Marines, marauders, medivacs, siege tanks, thors, vikings, banshees. Terran buildings lift off and land.
book.starmine.guide.21: Their base is a concrete square with turrets and bunkers. Under it lies a steel maze with labs and a reactor core. Above the clouds hangs the battlecruiser Hyperion.
book.starmine.guide.22:
9. Protoss

Probes warp in buildings, which need a pylon's power field. Zealots, stalkers, adepts, templars, immortals, colossi, void rays, carriers. Protoss shields come back after a fight.
book.starmine.guide.23: Their base is a sandstone plaza with a nexus and pylons; under it, ancient temples with shrines. Above floats the mothership. Dark templars hide in caves.
book.starmine.guide.24:
10. The world

Rare ruined terran outposts, zerg nests and xel'naga temples hide underground. Wild packs roam: zerg in caves, protoss by a lonely pylon, terrans at a campfire.
book.starmine.guide.25: The races claim land: a wild base sends parties to take caves and fields and dress them its way. Now and then they land a squad by your home; the game rule starmineAiPressure sets how often.
book.starmine.guide.26: Under each main base a stair leads to a portal hall. The portal is dark while its guards live: kill them and step in to reach the sky ship. Portal blocks break into armor shards.
book.starmine.guide.27:
11. Heroes

Kerrigan in the leviathan, Raynor on the Hyperion, Artanis in the mothership. At 2/3 health a hero calls its guard and restores shields; at 1/3 it rages. Reward: a full suit, 16 shards, 8 diamonds.
book.starmine.guide.28:
12. Guns, townsfolk

One villager in ten has an armed neighbour: a marshal with a gauss rifle or a ghost with a sniper rifle, invisible near foes. They shoot monsters and zerg and trade for emeralds.
book.starmine.guide.29:
Gauss rifle: 5 damage, 32 blocks, gauss rounds.
Sniper rifle: 16 damage, 64 blocks, canister rounds.
Right-click fires where you aim; walls stop the shot. Terran chests in dungeons hold guns too.
book.starmine.guide.30:
13. Goals

Your goals are in the Advancements screen (L), tab StarMine. /stargoals lists them and the next step; hints come now and then (game rule starmineHints).

Lost this book? /starguide.
book.starmine.guide.31:
Sides

Wild units are foes to every player. Your units are your allies and neutral to other players' units until struck. Villagers and golems leave your units alone unless they attack the village.

Good luck, commander.
book.starmine.guide.33:
Crafting

Command panel: map in the middle, repeaters and comparators round it.
Platform: map ringed by 8 armor shards.
Module: 3 shards, 2 mineral shards, a vespene bucket.
Suits: shards in vanilla armor shapes.
book.starmine.guide.32:
Races apart

The races are always foes. A pack, a claim or a nydus worm of one race never appears within 96 blocks of another race's wild. Packs wake for any player but a spectator.
book.starmine.field_guide.landing: Three races of StarCraft II have come to this world. This guide tells how to live among them and how to command them: your base, resources, the gear and its crafting, each race, the world and its heroes.
book.starmine.field_guide.name: StarMine Field Guide

book.starmine.moebius.1.title: Moebius Log: Specimens
book.starmine.moebius.1.page1: The zerg specimens arrived from the Koprulu fringe alive, as Dr. Narud wished. Cells two and three hold a hydralisk and an infestor. The infestor tries the glass every night.
book.starmine.moebius.1.page2: Narud insists on protoss essence as well. He will not say where he gets it. The crates come sealed with a sign none of us can read — a triangle of light.
book.starmine.moebius.1.page3: Security reminder: no one enters the east chamber alone. The marines are not told what is inside. Neither, in truth, are we.
book.starmine.moebius.2.title: Moebius Log: The Joining
book.starmine.moebius.2.page1: Trial 41. The zerg tissue took the protoss graft and did not reject it. For the first time the two lived in one body for more than a minute.
book.starmine.moebius.2.page2: It does not scream. It listens. When Narud enters, it turns its head to him before the door opens.
book.starmine.moebius.2.page3: Narud calls it "the first of the new ones". He speaks of a master who will return, and of a world remade. I write it down because I was told to write everything down.
book.starmine.moebius.3.title: Moebius Log: The Voice
book.starmine.moebius.3.page1: Three technicians report the same dream: a voice in the dark, older than the stars, calling itself by one name — Amun.
book.starmine.moebius.3.page2: The hybrid grows stronger when they sleep. The stasis field needs more power each day. Reactor two is at its limit.
book.starmine.moebius.3.page3: I asked Narud to stop. He smiled and said the work was never ours to stop. I am leaving this note where the next one will find it.
book.starmine.moebius.4.title: Moebius Log: The Last Entry
book.starmine.moebius.4.page1: The field failed at 03:12. The glass broke inward, as if pulled. The specimen did not run. It waited for us.
book.starmine.moebius.4.page2: The guards held the corridor. The zerg in the cells went still, as if they knew who their master was now.
book.starmine.moebius.4.page3: If you read this: the hybrid carries a relic of the xel'naga, the one Narud took from the triangle crates. Destroy the creature. Take the relic far from Amun's voice.
